verdict.rationale: Sign-in identity requirements are a fair question for a state business registry with online filing and prepaid accounts, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack describes the sign-in method, MFA, or whether biometric, in-person, or mailed-PIN verification is required. The 'Access your prepaid account' link and the Revenue Online mention do not document any authentication mechanism.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the published sign-in path is credential MFA an authorized human can complete remotely — not biometric liveness, an in-person visit, or a PIN by physical mail
